company.name: Socure
company.shortDescription: Socure provides digital identity verification, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance software through an AI-driven platform.
company.description: Socure develops predictive analytics and machine learning systems to automate consumer and business onboarding, identity verification, synthetic fraud detection, and sanctions screening. Commercial enterprises, financial institutions, online marketplaces, and public sector agencies utilize the technology to evaluate applicant risks, confirm document authenticity, and manage ongoing identity lifecycle requirements.

aiResearchSummary.text: Socure is researching stateless account authentication provable by a cryptographic biometric key, enabling recovery of user access through persistent unique identifiers. It develops generative systems and methods of feature extraction for enhancing entity matching, plus machine learning systems and methods for watchlist identity resolution and contextual decision making. Further work includes ai and vector based identity resolution, predictive document verification, fraud detection, barcode readability, and transaction score normalization. These efforts span digital identity, fraud mitigation, data extraction, and scoring.
